orgEncryptionTab.intro: The encryption key this organization's data is wrapped under. It can be set, replaced and rotated here; it is never displayed, and nothing on this deployment can show it to you or to anyone else.
orgEncryptionTab.unset: This organization has not set a key of its own. Its data is wrapped under the deployment's key.
orgEncryptionTab.modeGenerate: Generate one — it exists only in the ring and is shown to nobody
orgEncryptionTab.keyHelp: Base64 of 32 random bytes, e.g. openssl rand -base64 32. It is written once and never read back.
orgEncryptionTab.rotationNote: Rotating changes the key NEW data is wrapped under. The previous key is retired into the ring and goes on decrypting what it already wrote, so nothing becomes unreadable — and so a rotation is not a revocation.
